text:
maya: Quick sync — putting together the observability roadmap for next quarter. Need to finalize MVP scope for dashboards + tracing hooks + cost/error analytics. Customer asks from ACME and Beta: per-route cost breakdown, trace sampling controls for hotpaths, error grouping by model-version. Can we land launch criteria + scope cuts by EOD Friday?

samir: +1. From infra side priorities should be: accurate cost attribution and safe trace sampling. Suggested MVP: 1) basic cost per-route (top 10 routes), 2) tracing hooks for hotpaths with adjustable sampling, 3) error grouping with user-impact tags (no fancy UI yet).

elaine: For instrumentation: we can reuse most of the existing trace ingestion but need ~2 sprints for trace hook wiring and sampling config UI. If we need cuts, drop per-model breakdown and do per-route only for launch.

nick: Noted customer asks also include CSV export and prometheus metrics for pipeline-level KPIs. CSV seems low-effort if we expose the table backend. Do we want to include as a stretch? @maya

maya: CSV = stretch / nice-to-have. Minimal launch criteria (must-haves): 1) cost numbers within 10% of billing for sampled traffic, 2) trace hooks live in prod for top-3 routes, 3) error grouping surfaces actionable root-cause (stack + model-version). Nice-to-haves: CSV export, per-model breakdown, dashboard polish.

samir: Rollout plan suggestion: canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with auto-fallback on error/gap. Need guard rails on sampling to avoid billing blowups. Also add alerting for error-rate regressions and cost spikes.

elaine: Agree on rollout. For sampling config, propose schema:
```json
{"route": "string", "target_p50_ms": 200, "sampling_rate": 0.05, "auto_fallback": true}
```
We can ship CLI + small UI to edit a few routes initially.

nick: For the dashboard surface, MVP widget set: cost-summary, top-10 routes by spend, error-trend sparkline, sample-trace quick-link. Export and prometheus hooks as stretch.

maya: Team asks: can each of you post rough sprint points by tomorrow? I want a decision doc for execs: scope, launch criteria, rollback plan. Also capture customer-impact examples (ACME, Beta) to justify per-route focus.

deploy-bot: canary deploy for observability-trace-hooks started on infra-canary-3 (build 2026.17) :rocket:

samir: quick note — we should include an acceptance test: ingest X traces/minute and ensure UI latency < 300ms for dashboard queries. Otherwise the dashboard is useless.

elaine: putting estimates in the tracker now. Feels like a trimmed MVP is realistic in 3 sprints.

maya: Perfect. Scheduling a 30m decision huddle Thu 15:00 to lock scope. Thanks all — drop any customer quotes here if relevant. :thumbsup:
